steps.say: Modern ovarian stimulation relies on tailored gonadotropin preparations. Recombinant proteins offer pure single hormone activity without urinary metabolites. Purified extracts contain both active hormones.
steps.tx: Controlled ovarian stimulation utilizes **recombinant FSH** (follitropin alfa or beta) providing pure follicle-stimulating activity, or **hMG** supplying a balanced 1:1 ratio of FSH and **LH-like bioactivity** derived from the urinary hCG component in menotropin preparations. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

points: Pure FSH without LH or hCG

right.title: Highly Purified hMG (HP-hMG)
points: Balanced 75 IU FSH and 75 IU LH
LH activity driven by hCG content
Preferred in advanced age and hypo-responders

steps.say: Initial dosing algorithms prevent both hyperstimulation and poor yield. Starting doses reflect individual baseline biomarkers. Normal responders begin within a standardized window.
steps.tx: In the **GnRH antagonist protocol**, administration on fixed day 6 or flexible lead follicle >=14 mm reduces severe OHSS by >50 percent compared to agonist protocols. Effective **lead follicle 14 mm** tracking and **OHSS reduction** make antagonist cycles the standard of care.

steps.say: Suppression of endogenous pituitary surges is essential during multi follicular recruitment. Antagonist protocols block receptors instantaneously without any initial stimulation. Fixed and flexible timing schedules govern antagonist introduction.
steps.tx: To prevent premature LH surges, **Cetrorelix** or **Ganirelix** is administered at an **antagonist dose** of 0.25 mg daily subcutaneous. Competitive blockade of pituitary GnRH receptors provides immediate suppression without any initial flare, maintaining follicular coordination. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

steps.say: Classic agonist suppression takes advantage of complete receptor desensitization. Administration begins in the preceding luteal phase to avoid flare interference. Stimulation starts once deep down regulation is verified.
steps.tx: The classic **long agonist protocol** initiates **mid-luteal downregulation** on cycle day 21 for 10 to 14 days before starting exogenous gonadotropins. Verifying profound pituitary desensitization and complete **estradiol suppression** (<50 pg/mL) avoids premature surges during ovarian stimulation. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

steps.say: High responding patients require specialized surge prevention strategies. Antagonist protocols uniquely permit substituting the trigger agent. Displacing chorionic gonadotropin eliminates dangerous vascular permeability.
steps.tx: In high-risk antagonist cycles, substituting hCG with a **GnRH agonist trigger** (leuprolide 0.2 mg or triptorelin 0.2 mg) induces an endogenous **luteal surge** that results in complete **OHSS elimination**, making freeze-all management exceptionally safe for vulnerable patients. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

points: High risk of severe early and late OHSS

steps.say: Patients with impaired ovarian reserve benefit from microdose flare approaches. Administering low dose agonist stimulates endogenous gonadotropin release. The added pituitary boost enhances small follicle rescue.
steps.tx: For expected poor responders and **low responders**, the **microdose flare** protocol utilizes an initial **endogenous flare** of pituitary FSH and LH on cycle days 2 to 4 to rescue growing cohorts before initiating high-dose exogenous gonadotropin therapy. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.

nodes.label: Discontinue OCP; start microdose leuprolide 40-50 mcg BD
Endogenous flare release of pituitary FSH/LH
Add exogenous gonadotropins 300 to 450 IU on Day 3

steps.say: Elevations in late follicular progesterone impair uterine receptivity. Premature secretory transformation closes the implantation gate. Freezing the resulting blastocysts circumvents poor fresh transfer outcomes.
steps.tx: A final **hCG trigger** using recombinant hCG (250 mcg) or urinary hCG (5000 to 10000 IU) is timed when at least 2 to 3 follicles reach 17 to 18 mm in **follicle diameter**, driving final **oocyte maturation** and nuclear progression prior to retrieval.

steps.say: Accurate timing of the final trigger ensures optimal oocyte maturity. Triggering is scheduled once follicles achieve preovulatory size. Oocyte aspiration follows at a precise interval.
steps.tx: Transvaginal ultrasound-guided **oocyte pickup** (OPU) is scheduled exactly 35 to **36 hours post-trigger**, performing transvaginal **follicular aspiration** immediately preceding natural follicular rupture to harvest mature metaphase II oocytes safely. Structured diagnostic algorithms and evidence-based reproductive protocols guide tailored clinical interventions across modern fertility management.
